description: Asks to confirm an important action, such as cancelling an order. It does not close on an outside click — the user must choose.

guidelines.verbs: Label buttons with clear verbs ("Ya, Batalkan"), not "OK". Use variant="destructive" for dangerous actions.
guidelines.outside: Explain the consequence in the description, such as when the money is refunded.

small.title: Small Size
small.description: size="sm": narrow and centered with two equal buttons — good for phones.

props.size: md = wide with the icon on the left (large screens), sm = narrow and centered.
